contains: A hangar of cold air and sodium light. The courier ship squats on its skids in the middle of the bay, its boarding ramp drawn up tight. A loader robot waits beside the ramp, and empty mail crates are stacked along the west wall. The depot is back through the door to the west.
trundles it up the ramp again

The Sparrow's hold, a steel room no wider than a corridor, ribbed with cargo netting. A suit locker stands bolted to the aft bulkhead, and a ladder climbs to the cockpit hatch at the forward end. The ramp slopes down to the dock.

The Sparrow's nose, two steps across. A flight couch faces a console of switches and a single dark viewport, and the ladder drops back through the hatch to the hold. Everything in here is worn to bare metal by somebody's gloves.
Somebody has taped a photograph of a dog to the edge of the console.
A single pane of layered glass
The Sparrow will not fold with its pilot standing up.
You get into the flight couch.
The fold drive hums to life.
the hangar folds away like a letter.
